essence: The eighth Kali age contains a mantra capable of granting all accomplishments.
The mantra to be taught is equivalent in efficacy to the twelve-syllable mantra.
The mantra 'klīṃ kṛṣṇāya govindāya' is considered an eight-syllable mantra.
The ritual procedures for this mantra follow the same pattern as before.
The mantra of the born Kṛṣṇa is 'oṃ namo' followed by the specified Kṛṣṇa-ending form.
